A brass ball and a feather are released at the same time.
On Earth, the ball reaches the ground first.
On the Moon, they reach the ground at the same time.
What is the explanation for this?
A
Both weigh the same on the Moon.
B
Both weigh less on the Moon.
C
There is a greater air resistance on the Moon.
D
There is no air resistance on the Moon.

options.label: A
options.text: Both weigh the same on the Moon.

options.label: B
options.text: Both weigh less on the Moon.

options.label: C
options.text: There is a greater air resistance on the Moon.

options.label: D
options.text: There is no air resistance on the Moon.
